customer_reply: Hello, thank you for contacting Zycus Support. We take reports of potential data visibility issues extremely seriously. We have engaged our Security team immediately to investigate this report regarding the sourcing event. We advise pausing the affected sourcing event until our Security team confirms containment. We will provide an update shortly.
internal_note: Customer reported supplier visibility into competing supplier's bid amounts during a reverse auction. Per KB-6401, any report of suspected data exposure between suppliers or tenants must be classified as category='security', priority='P1', routed to 'security', and escalated immediately. Do not attempt to reproduce in tenant.
